provenance.construction: Two-block group-algebra CSS code over the affine group Aff(F_19)=C_19 semidirect C_18 with action r=2: H_X=[L(a)|R(b)], H_Z=[R(b)^T|L(a)^T], with a=[182,323,76,217] and b=[294,208,142,82]. The group has order 342, so n=684 and every check has weight 8.
provenance.notes: Equivalence check: checked against the current board entries and their published construction data; not equivalent to an existing entry. Screening used 100 RIS trials over 3,000 one- and two-support mutations around the affine [[684,8,85]] point, followed by 2,000-trial confirmation of 80 finalists. Deep re-verification used three independent 1,000,000-trial RIS passes with pair depths 24, 32, and 48; the minimum returned was 73. The X witness of weight 73 and the Z witness of weight 94 were independently checked in the opposite-check kernels and outside the stabilizer row spaces.
